My office joined Full Sail University today for the official ribbon cutting of their new Drone Innovation Center, a major step forward for Florida’s leadership in cutting-edge technology and workforce development.

This state-of-the-art, 7,800+ sq. ft. facility will give students hands-on experience in drone technologies while bringing together talent from AI, simulation engineering, AR/VR, software engineering, IT, computer science, cybersecurity, live event production, and more.

Full Sail continues to set the standard as one of the few institutions in the country offering these advanced programs all under one roof, preparing the next generation of innovators who will shape our national security, tech sector, and growing Florida economy.

Great day for Central Florida and for America’s future workforce.

Today, I spoke before the House Foreign Affairs Committee about the growing axis of evil — North Korea, China, Russia, and Iran — and the need to keep putting pressure on these regimes.

The United States has the ability to lead and expand in critical areas like artificial intelligence and drone capabilities, but only if we act with urgency. Ensuring America remains technologically and militarily superior is essential to our national security and global leadership.

I’m proud to stand with the hardworking small businesses across Florida’s 7th District by voting in favor of H.R. 3679, the Small Business Artificial Intelligence Advancement Act. 

This bill directs NIST to develop practical, technology-neutral resources that help our local entrepreneurs inFL-07 to address AI concerns, drive innovation, and compete in today’s fast-evolving economy, without burdensome mandates.

I'm proud to deliver real, long-term support to the job creators and family-owned businesses that power FL-07 communities.

Honored to pass this amendment to protect our military installations from Chinese components being used in data centers on our installations. This bill protects national security, promotes American businesses, and builds industry capability.

Economic security is national security. President Trump’s Pax Silica initiative strengthens trusted partnerships to secure critical supply chains, from AI and semiconductors to energy and critical minerals, ensuring America leads the industries that will define the future. https://t.co/s8w0HAq6qY
